content.title: Stay in the loop
content.copy: Get notified when someone accepts your introduction, when an Auto Match is ready, or when an event is about to start.

conditional_interactions.source_screen: Onboarding / Notifications / Pre-Permission; user-authorized real-permission failure closure
conditional_interactions.trigger: Click or keyboard activation when actual notification status is denied
conditional_interactions.preconditions: Valid onboarding context; no permission request or persistence operation in progress
conditional_interactions.visible_feedback: Open Settings appears only for a real denied status; request failure remains readable
conditional_interactions.success_result: The trusted native adapter opens this app's system settings
conditional_interactions.failure_result: Stay on Notifications with a truthful settings error; do not change permission or onboarding state
conditional_interactions.sync_scope: Read the real notification status again on foreground return
conditional_interactions.acceptance: With a denied OS status, open Settings once; without a host, verify an explicit error and zero writes

approved_deltas: Use the real top and bottom safe-area values instead of the prototype's fixed canvas insets.

2026-10-26 user request: custom permission buttons are Continue / Cancel. Continue directly invokes the existing system notification request from this pre-prompt, without a second custom permission page or a fabricated grant.

Cancel makes no system request. It shows the required 400-600ms custom Loading before persisting only the onboarding notification choice; an actual denied/unavailable status is preserved, otherwise the choice is skipped.
A real denied notification status exposes the conditional Open Settings action; system-owned permission dialog text remains unchanged.
Persistence and access failures render an explicit in-page error and do not navigate.
